dietary_constraint_target_check.name: dietary_constraint_target_check
dietary_constraint_target_check.value: "dietary_constraint"."food_id" is not null or "dietary_constraint"."label_ko" is not null

nutrient_profile_nonnegative_values_chec.name: nutrient_profile_nonnegative_values_check
nutrient_profile_nonnegative_values_chec.value:
("nutrient_profile"."energy_millicalories" is null or "nutrient_profile"."energy_millicalories" >= 0)
        and ("nutrient_profile"."carbohydrate_mg" is null or "nutrient_profile"."carbohydrate_mg" >= 0)
        and ("nutrient_profile"."protein_mg" is null or "nutrient_profile"."protein_mg" >= 0)
        and ("nutrient_profile"."fat_mg" is null or "nutrient_profile"."fat_mg" >= 0)
        and ("nutrient_profile"."fiber_mg" is null or "nutrient_profile"."fiber_mg" >= 0)

calculation_snapshot_values_check.name: calculation_snapshot_values_check
calculation_snapshot_values_check.value:
"calculation_snapshot"."energy_millicalories" >= 0
        and "calculation_snapshot"."carbohydrate_mg" >= 0
        and "calculation_snapshot"."protein_mg" >= 0
        and "calculation_snapshot"."fat_mg" >= 0
        and ("calculation_snapshot"."fiber_mg" is null or "calculation_snapshot"."fiber_mg" >= 0)

image_asset_dimensions_check.name: image_asset_dimensions_check
image_asset_dimensions_check.value:
("image_asset"."pixel_width" is null and "image_asset"."pixel_height" is null)
        or ("image_asset"."pixel_width" > 0 and "image_asset"."pixel_height" > 0)

image_asset_status_timestamps_check.name: image_asset_status_timestamps_check
image_asset_status_timestamps_check.value:
("image_asset"."status" <> 'processed' or "image_asset"."processing_completed_at" is not null)
        and ("image_asset"."status" <> 'deletion_pending' or "image_asset"."deletion_requested_at" is not null)
        and ("image_asset"."status" <> 'deleted' or "image_asset"."deleted_at" is not null)

meal_item_confidence_check.name: meal_item_confidence_check
meal_item_confidence_check.value:
("meal_item"."recognition_confidence_bps" is null or "meal_item"."recognition_confidence_bps" between 0 and 10000)
        and ("meal_item"."mapping_confidence_bps" is null or "meal_item"."mapping_confidence_bps" between 0 and 10000)
        and ("meal_item"."portion_confidence_bps" is null or "meal_item"."portion_confidence_bps" between 0 and 10000)

meal_log_recognition_ready_check.name: meal_log_recognition_ready_check
meal_log_recognition_ready_check.value:
"meal_log"."recognition_status" <> 'ready'
        or ("meal_log"."recognition_provider" is not null
        and "meal_log"."recognition_model" is not null
        and "meal_log"."recognition_prompt_version" is not null
        and "meal_log"."recognition_schema_version" is not null
        and "meal_log"."recognition_result" is not null
        and jsonb_typeof("meal_log"."recognition_result") = 'object'
        and "meal_log"."recognition_result" ? 'foods'
        and jsonb_typeof("meal_log"."recognition_result"->'foods') = 'array'
        and "meal_log"."recognition_completed_at" is not null)

meal_log_status_timestamps_check.name: meal_log_status_timestamps_check
meal_log_status_timestamps_check.value:
("meal_log"."status" <> 'confirmed' or "meal_log"."confirmed_at" is not null)
        and ("meal_log"."status" <> 'deleted' or ("meal_log"."deleted_at" is not null and "meal_log"."purge_after" is not null))

meal_log_recognition_processing_lease_ch.name: meal_log_recognition_processing_lease_check
meal_log_recognition_processing_lease_ch.value:
("meal_log"."recognition_status" = 'processing'
        and "meal_log"."recognition_lease_token" is not null
        and "meal_log"."recognition_lease_expires_at" is not null)
        or ("meal_log"."recognition_status" <> 'processing'
        and "meal_log"."recognition_lease_token" is null
        and "meal_log"."recognition_lease_expires_at" is null)

meal_log_recognition_retry_schedule_chec.name: meal_log_recognition_retry_schedule_check
meal_log_recognition_retry_schedule_chec.value:
"meal_log"."recognition_status" not in ('pending', 'failed')
        or "meal_log"."recognition_next_attempt_at" is not null

nutrition_profile_body_metrics_check.name: nutrition_profile_body_metrics_check
nutrition_profile_body_metrics_check.value:
("nutrition_profile"."birth_year" is null or "nutrition_profile"."birth_year" between 1900 and 2100)
        and ("nutrition_profile"."height_mm" is null or "nutrition_profile"."height_mm" > 0)
        and ("nutrition_profile"."weight_g" is null or "nutrition_profile"."weight_g" > 0)

nutrition_profile_targets_check.name: nutrition_profile_targets_check
nutrition_profile_targets_check.value:
"nutrition_profile"."calorie_target_millicalories" > 0
        and "nutrition_profile"."carbohydrate_target_mg" >= 0
        and "nutrition_profile"."protein_target_mg" >= 0
        and "nutrition_profile"."fat_target_mg" >= 0
        and "nutrition_profile"."fiber_target_mg" >= 0
        and "nutrition_profile"."activity_coefficient_bps" > 0
        and "nutrition_profile"."base_eer_millicalories" > 0

user_profile_onboarding_status_check.name: user_profile_onboarding_status_check
user_profile_onboarding_status_check.value:
("user_profile"."onboarding_status" = 'pending' and "user_profile"."onboarding_completed_at" is null)
        or ("user_profile"."onboarding_status" <> 'pending' and "user_profile"."onboarding_completed_at" is not null)
